tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Attorney General shall provide an increase in the amount provided to a State under the covered formula grants under this chapter for a 2-year period.

tree.heading: Limit
tree.text: The Attorney General may not provide an increase in the amount provided to a State under the covered formula grants under this chapter more than 4 times.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 14043h–5 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
